name: GHCL Ltd
title: GHCL Ltd - 500171 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Soda ash prices still under pressure with volume up ~11% but pricing down ~10% YoY; capacity cuts only "some time away" and new Greenfield soda ash timeline unset, though management says costs are now being passed through.

capex.peers_comment: Chinese supply reduction is some time away; one US facility of 1.3 million tons mothballed; Inner Mongolia added around 7 million tons.
capex.quote: one of the US facility has been kind of a mothball, okay, which is roughly 1.3 million tons

triggers.label: US soda ash 1.3Mt mothballed
triggers.quote: one of the US facility has been kind of a mothball, okay, which is roughly 1.3 million tons

triggers.label: Volume +11%, pricing -10%
triggers.quote: there is approximately around 11% of the volume growth has happened, whereas your pricing has gone down by 10%

triggers.label: Imports down, industry inventory eased
triggers.quote: the imports have significantly come down in the last quarter

triggers.label: Chinese supply cut 'some time away'
triggers.quote: meaningful supply reduction remains some time away

triggers.label: Greenfield soda ash timeline unset
triggers.quote: at this point of time very specifically it will be difficult to say when we are starting the construction

guidance.metric: FY27 bromine and vacuum salt revenue
guidance.value: approx INR 120 crore in FY27; ~INR 160 crore full-year; EBITDA margin 40-45%
guidance.quote: In FY27, this number will be INR 120 crores approximately. The margin remains almost the same level at 40-45%.

guidance.metric: Bromine and vacuum salt full commissioning
guidance.quote: We expect full commissioning to take place in Q1 FY27.

guidance.metric: Peak revenue from bromine and vacuum salt
guidance.quote: I said that the peak numbers will be INR 170 crores.
